column1: # BL-973 suite manifest: every test file under swarmforge/scripts/test/ is
# accounted for here, in exactly one lane. This file IS the standing suite
# entry point's list - run_bb_suite.sh runs the "standing" rows - so there is
# one source of truth rather than a runner list and a manifest that can
# disagree. suite_inventory_cli.bb fails if the tree and this file diverge.
# Column 1 must NAME A TEST FILE - test_*.sh or *_test_runner.bb, directly in
# this directory. BL-1239: three rows put the ticket id there and pushed the
# filename to column 3; they registered nothing while looking like a
# registration. The inventory gate now rejects such a row by name. A property
# runner has its own lane and is never a suite member, so it is not a legal
#   lane "standing" - run by run_bb_suite.sh. date and reason are empty.
#   lane "excluded" - NOT run. Both date (YYYY-MM-DD) and reason are
#                     REQUIRED. Legitimate reasons are slow, manual, or
#                     live-only. "It is failing" is NOT a reason to exclude:
#                     a red test belongs in the standing lane, reported red.
#                     Hiding it here is the very thing this ticket removes.
# Adding a test file: add a row. The inventory gate fails until you do, which
# is deliberate - three tests sat red and unrun for days because nothing
